title: cmake: drop duplicate deduplication of linker flags
body:
In favor of the one within the `if(_ldflags)` block.

Follow-up to 16f073ef49f94412000218c9f6ad04e3fd7e4d01 #16973

files.patch:
@@ -2242,8 +2242,6 @@ if(NOT CURL_DISABLE_INSTALL)
     endif()
   endforeach()
 
-  list(REMOVE_DUPLICATES _ldflags)
-
   if(LIBCURL_PC_REQUIRES_PRIVATE)
     list(REMOVE_DUPLICATES LIBCURL_PC_REQUIRES_PRIVATE)
     string(REPLACE ";" "," LIBCURL_PC_REQUIRES_PRIVATE "${LIBCURL_PC_REQUIRES_PRIVATE}")
